elements.label: Strength
elements.description: Flesh and bone quiver beneath the weight of the unnatural. Excess vitality courses through the veins, spilling out from the fingertips. The signs of strength are undeniable.

elements.label: Whimsy
elements.description: Inspiration kindles flame, and change follows.

elements.label: Revelation
elements.description: Clarity of mind like glass, thoughts swift as light—today, the Glory has bestowed its gift.

slots.label: Target
slots.description: Place to hidden enemies and reveal them, or place in city for rapid reconnaissance.

elements.label: Grief
elements.description: Matters we dread to face, yet are powerless to change.

elements.label: Memory of Sights
elements.description: Faraway, wonders, and forbidden paths.[This influence does not fade with time.]

elements.label: A Wasteland
elements.description: No danger, nor any worth to speak of.

elements.label: Dawn
elements.description:
A new day, new possibilities.

[Use this card during the Season of Past Stirrings along with a Desire card to change the game objective.]

elements.label: Noon
elements.description:
Still bright, but its former colors are no more.

[Use this card during the Season of Past Stirrings along with a Desire card to change the game objective.]

elements.label: Sunset
elements.description:
The heat of light is most intense in the afternoon—though nightfall is not far off.

[Use this card during the Season of Past Stirrings along with a Desire card to change the game objective.]

elements.label: Night
elements.description: Night is cold, yet merciful: it promises darkness, silence, and concealment.

elements.label: Fog
elements.description: Heavy, misty fog provides concealment.

elements.label: Moonlight
elements.description: What is within, without; what is without, within. The Meniscate once gazed upon this place.

elements.label: Chill
elements.description: The cold of ice and snow stings the flesh, yet from it we may learn patience and silence.

elements.label: Rain
elements.description: The wound of the earth heals through this baptism.

elements.label: Flame
elements.description: Power shall find its release in its warm touch.

elements.label: Tide
elements.description: Ceaseless flow, endless devouring. Occasionally, a hint of coral-like scent slips through—ancient and faint—or perhaps it is merely illusion.

elements.label: Opportunity: To Make A Kind of Special Ammunition?
elements.description: I can command the craftsmen of this place to forge these specialized bullets for me, so long as I supply the necessary materials. [An opportunity to exchange Necessities for ammunition.]

slots.label: Necessities
slots.description: Place enough Necessities to complete the trade.

elements.label: Opportunity: Gunpowder From Adepts?
elements.description: I know of a few adepts who’ve stashed away some delightfully dangerous items in a secluded part of the district. They aren’t usually willing to trade—but only a fool would turn down more practical supplies right now.[An opportunity to exchange Necessities for consumable.]

slots.label: Necessities
slots.description: Place enough Necessities to complete the trade.

elements.label: Opportunity: A Farm?
elements.description: The times may be tense, but farmers always try to keep extra supplies stocked—I can personally pay them a visit and help take inventory of their reserves. [An opportunity to get a few Necessities.]

elements.label: Opportunity: A Preparation That Stirs Passion?
elements.description: A few Moth adepts here possess the craft of refining substances of chaos at midnight. Some hard currency would suffice to have them perform the work for me. [An opportunity to exchange Necessities for consumable.]

elements.label: Opportunity: A Grail Ingredient
elements.description: Several Grail adepts here have mastered the art of extracting unique seasonings from the tides. Some hard currency would suffice to have them perform the work for me. [An opportunity to exchange Necessities for consumable.]

slots.label: Necessities
slots.description: Place enough Necessities to complete the trade.

elements.label: Opportunity: Support From Royalists?
elements.description: It is no great task to rally my followers once more—I need only find the right words, then spare a little breath to speak them. [An opportunity to gain mundane support.]

slots.label: Ability
slots.description: Insert an appropriate ability to achieve alignment.

elements.label: Opportunity: Support From Army?
elements.description: A force loyal to me is garrisoned here. As long as necessary provisions are supplied, they will fight for me. [An opportunity to gain mundane support.]

slots.description: Place enough Necessities to complete the trade.

elements.label: Opportunity: Seize Supplies?
elements.description: A shipment of precious wartime supplies was intercepted mid‑route by conflict and artillery. With just a little more time, they will all be mine.[An opportunity to get Necessities]
